newsitem.title: USA: UPS set to announce information technology plan.
newsitem.headline: UPS set to announce information technology plan.

text.p: United Parcel Services said it would make a major strategic announcement relating to information technology at 1100 EDT on Wednesday.
A UPS spokeswoman said the company would discuss its new technology strategy for the future, including its implications for customer service.
"It's a statement of direction," a spokeswoman said.
Senior information technology executives would also talk about UPS On-Line and worldwide technology expansion plans, she said, declining to give further details.
She said the announcement was not directly related to the company's international logistic efforts.
